It doesn't dry one out but there is no additional hydrating affect that I can tell.  It is just neutral which is nice for an exfoliating product.  I live in AZ so hydration is a major part of skin care for me. This is exfoliating but not hydrating in my opinion.  And when you think on it, exfoliating and hydrating is an oxymoron.  I don't know how it would do with retinal at night as I've read mixed reviews on using this together with a retinoid - some say definitely don't do, others say it's ok. I tend to be more cautious and have not done.  I'm thinking this could be useful one or two nights a week where one doesn't use a retinoid, or during days when not going anywhere. Review Title: At first I thought this was amazing, but then...
Review: Ugh. I was SO excited to try this based on the rave reviews I read. This is going to be a long review, because I feel I should be specific. I have tried way too many products to count over the last few years, from natural remedies, organic oil cleansing, drugstore products, expensive creams and potions, even Rodan and Fields, and nothing has Worked for me. I was really hoping this would be my miracle. I am in my mid 30's and have been suffering from breakouts for years now, when I never did as a teen. I get a lot of cystic acne and would do anything to fix this awful, humiliating problem. I thought for the longest time that my skin was oily, so for years I have been treating it that way, and drying the hell out of it to the point were it looks dehydrated and dull. On top of that, I get oily, especially in the T zone, BUT also have random dry patches on my nose and in between my eyebrows, and sometimes on the cheeks. I know that hormones and diet are greatly related to skin issues, but I also think the right products for your specific skin type are important and can make a difference.After reading an article on the Paula's Choice website about who BHA's are great for, I seemed to fit the bill 100%. The first night I used it, my hyperpigmented, angry skin looked better already! I was so excited and thought it was gonna be amazing! I used it the next morning and my skin felt too tight during the day, almost likeHow it does after too much sun, so I cut back to using it nightly instead. I do notice it leaves a sort of oily film, and anything oily scares me because it usually means instant breakout. Same thing happens to me with humidity. My skins sucks!!A few days after I used it I started getting random, painful pimples in places I don't normally break out. I know about purging and hoped It was that, but I don't think it is anymore. I started getting one new blemish a day, and most were on either side of my nose (where I never break out) and a few on my cheeks, and the rest scattered around my forehead. I used this for about 2 weeks and then stopped because I can't take it anymore. We had a day of humidity here and that was it- my skin became a mess! So now I'm back to square one...I do think this product could be good for some people, but it is making my specific skin worse :(

Review Title: Very oily/ acne prone, Tretinoin user
Review: (TDLR - Not crazy about the greasy texture, despite good results. And a little goes a VERY long way.)For starters, I began using this exfoliant along with Tretinoin .05% with the intent of exfoliating dead skin cells, and reducing blackheads and the size of large pores. I use tret every other night, and apply this product 2-3 times a week on my off days. I have not experienced any irritation, but I also make sure I moisturize the **** out of my skin, and avoid dry/flaky areas when they are present.Initially I HATED the greasy texture of this stuff, and due to my very oily skin I thought for sure it would cause a breakout. It really made my skin feel really oily, slick, and shiny, and after waiting 20 minutes to see it it would sink in (it didn't)  I had to wash it off.I realized that maybe I applied way too much, and so reapplied it using only a very small amount on the cotton pad. The end result was so much better, so you only need a VERY thin to come into contact with your skin. After about 20 mins, most of it will sink in, but a very thin film will remain on top of the skin. Therefore some may prefer to use this at night.ANYWHO, despite the slightly oily texture - I have not had any breakouts, and my pores and skin texture has improved immensely. Don't expect to see results on the first and second use, I didn't notice much change until about 1-2 weeks of application.So far I like the results of this product, and it is gentle and effective enough that it works well in combination with tretinoin. And despite my results and the fact that it hasn't made me break out - I'm still not crazy about the texture of this formula, therefore I'm not sure I will be repurchasing this product when I run out. Especially because at this high price point, it needs to be something that I truly 100% love.

Review Title: If you actually understand how to use it, it's amazing.
Review: My skin type:- Very Dry, easily dehydrated- Oily nose- Prone to stubborn acne and closed comedones- Redness on chin and cheeks (not rosacea)I already use a nightly Tretinoin cream (.04% concentration) to help with my acne and premature signs of aging but decided with my derm that incorporating a BHA would be a good idea to help with my seriously stubborn closed comedones and some irritating textural issues. It was between this and the Cerave SA lotion and I ultimately decided on this due to the higher concentration of salicylic acid.It's moisturizing, and feels sticky for the first 5-10 minutes after application but seems to sinks in to something of a satin finish on me and I can no longer feel it on my skin. You just have to be a little patient. My skin feels well hydrated and plump after it settles and looks really smooth and my pores aren't as obvious. It sits just fine under makeup for me but I'm not a new user to chemical exfoliants so I don't have lots of dead skin pilling up or sloughing off when I use it, my skin is, for the most part, already very smooth outside the acne and CCs. Occasionally I'll apply it further down my neck/decolletage than usual and WOW do I old skin just ball up and peel right away - it's so gross but also satisfying. So those that don't exfoliate often or are new to BHA/AHAs will likely have issues with foundation until their skin adjusts (but it will adjust). My advice in those cases is to either use this at night for the first few weeks or just accept going barefaced for a little while if you can.I'd strongly suggest not applying this product over anything that you feel does not dry down fully, the times I've attempted to use it after serums or heavier products it takes forever to sink in and sometimes never fully does. I save all my serums and essences for after this has absorbed and it's far easier to work with it as a result. My steps go like this most days: ACWell Licorice toner --- PC 2% BHA --- 10% Niacinamide serum --- TO Matryxil serum --- Secret Key Black Snail cream or Syn-ake cream w/ 3 drops Stratia Fortify oil --- Sunscreen.It works fairly quickly IMO, on my neck where I typically don't apply my Tret at night I noticed the peeling and balling of dead skin on day one and on my face where I have a patch of really awful CCs I noticed them getting smaller and smoother by around day 3-4. I'm going on about 8 days now and they're barely visible unless I'm right up in the mirror and feel as if they're almost gone when I touch my fingers to that area. I do have some slight peeling of the skin around my mouth and nose but it's not terrible (likely because I already exfoliate the heck out of my skin with the tret).Some tips and things keep in mind:1)DO NOT RINSE IT OFF. I don't understand some of the top reviews advising people to do that, it says on the bottle not to rinse and nearly all chemical exfoliators are meant to be left on until the next cleansing specifically so they can do their job. If you rinse it off you're either going to prevent it from properly exfoliating or end up irritating the hell out of your skin. If you have oily skin and feel this might be heavy on you than you can probably just use this on bare skin and  then sunscreen if you use in the AM or a lightweight lotion/cream and be done with it, but you need to leave it on your skin.2)You have got to use sunscreen while you're using this product! Any BHA or AHA exfoliant causes increased sun sensitivity and you have to address that in your routine. You should already use sunscreen daily but it becomes a must when you incorporate a chemical exfoliator or you risk sun damage.3)Less is more! Don't slop this on your face or soak a cotton pad in it, a little goes a long way and you'll be kicking yourself if you apply way too much and have to wait 20+ minutes for it to sink in. Use a shake or two and add more if needed but go easy.4)Expect some irritation initially. Chemical exfoliants can be harsh and rough even on sturdy skin and you have to give yourself time to adjust. Over-exfoliation is a possibility but sometimes just introducing a BHA or AHA into your routine can cause some sensitivity. Don't panic and just be gentle to your skin. Use ceramides (like Cerave Skin Renewing cream) or fatty oils to soothe your face if needed and try to stay away from any harsh products or acids like Vitamin C right after applying this to avoid really burning your face.

Review: Let me start by saying I have congested skin, so I know I need an exfoliant. I have used a large number of scrubs, peels, etc. throughout the years and most were bleh. I had become frustrated recently once again with my skin needing help and I saw this item. I decided to try it, and I have used it two nights in a row.Outcome: I could see a significant difference after just the first night. This morning after the second night/application, I still saw an improvement. I am excited that my skin is looking smoother, clearer, and has smaller pores after just two days. I repeat TWO DAYS. I will keep putting it on every night since it does leave a bit of a residue on the skin that I feel I would not like during the day (but maybe it was because I put a lot of it on). Overall, I will continue to use it. And for it being as effective as it is, I don't think it's going to irritate or make my skin red like some other exfoliants have used. But if anything changes I will update my review. Right now, if I could give this 10 stars I would.Also, I feel like this will only help people who have skin that needs exfoliating. If you have decent skin or skin that doesn't need exfoliating, it may not be that amazing nor effective. But it all depends on what your skin needs, so if you have any needs that this product addresses I think you should give it a go. It at least won't harm or irritate your skin.*Disclaimer: I put on a significant amount of this both nights, probably about a good double dose all over my face and the front of my neck and rubbed it in a bit with the cotton pad. I am certain this sped up the exfoliating process, and as I continue to use it I will probably go down to putting on just one application rather than a double application each night. I may eventually go to every other night, but that remains to be seen. I will just go with the flow and do whatever my skin needs. So far, amazingly effective.UPDATE: After the 3rd double application last night, I am STILL seeing an improvement in my skin. I will go down to a normal nightly application starting tonight since my skin is feeling a bit tight. It isn't inflamed but I can tell it could become irritated if I continue double strength applications daily. And my skin is much improved already, so there is no reason to risk irritation. I will update how the regular single application works. Oh, I am seeing wrinkles diminish as well under and around my eyes!UPDATE #2: After the normal single application last night my skin is still improving. It doesn't feel as tight as yesterday, so it was a good I listened to my skin. Will continue with single layer nightly applications! Still loving it!UPDATE #3: After several more days of using it only at night and an overall single application (with a little extra on certain areas of my face), my skin is still continuing to improve. I am definitely sold on this.UPDATE #4: After almost another week of use it feels like my skin has gotten used to it so I will be using a light coating in the morning with moisturizer afterward, and a heavy application at night also with moisturizer after. I will let the exfoliant fully dry before putting on the moisturizer to make sure it stays where it should. I will report back on how it goes. Fine lines are diminishing and it seems like a few darker spots on my face are slowly lightening. So far, I am still loving it. (I am also putting it on the front of my neck and upper chest and it's helping there as well.) HOWEVER, I am not a person who puts on foundation or much makeup, so I am not sure how using this during the day would affect someone the foundation staying in place or not. Once I am back to my normal work outside the house I may decide to use it only at night, we will see.UPDATE #5: I am still using this daily twice a day and still seeing improvement in my skin. A few darker patches of skin near my temples are lightening, my pores are still getting smaller, and my fine lines are still diminishing. I have set this up on a subscription because it works so well for me. I hope this review helped you!

Review: I bought the in December last year.  As usual I broke out .... But hear me out first!  I have very fair sensitive skin. The stronger the medicinal content the more drying.  The less drying the more severe the breakouts.  After shelving this product , I stumbled on an article about little known beauty secrets... Believe it or not it recommended aquaphor (yes same stuff used for diaper rashes) as a moisturizer. So I said what the neck I've tried everything else.  It changed everything!!!!  My skin still broke out but the drying aspect totally changed. I could feel and see my skin improving.  It had been a few months since I had tried the pc exfoliation and I began to wonder if it would still break me out, so I tried again.This has changed my life!?!  Within a week my breakouts reduced to half and any breakouts duration was reduced to days instead of weeks. Over the two months I've been using Paula's choice I've added more their products.  I now use cleaner, toner, exfoliant.  I still use aquaphor as my nighttime moisturizer. I use Paula's choice moisturizer with sunscreen with pc boost mixed in for daytime.  I hardly breakout now even during my period.  Guys I'm in tears as I write this.  Honestly to be able to walk outdoors without tons of concealer and full makeup.... There are no words.My skin tone has evened out the redness gone.  If anyone has suffered with this then II want to say there is hope.  Few things 1. If you use the aquaphor the beware it is grease, very greasey. When I use it before bed I try to rub in as much as possible, when I wake up though it is completely absorbed. I used this alone for weeks, I didn't try other products until I realized my skin texture had changed and become more supple. 2. Exfolliator is a chemical and a little goes long way. Personally patting it in with fingertips was best, don't rub or smear on.  Start with once day, I have now worked up to morning and evening usage.  This can burn you. I have been overzealous and used too much because I was excited with results.  When this happened rinsed off face and kept covered with aquaphor and burns healed by morning.I'm know now that my face was in no shape for products because of ph balance and that is why everything exasperated already horrible breakouts.  I'm no doctor or chemist but I can say that right now this is the first time I can walk out of the house without covering in makeup, hats, and long hair.  You wouldn't believe the feeling when friends who see me say, "wow your skin looks amazing!" My skin looks better than when I was in my teens.  I've now got my teen using Paula's choice clear skin line and aquaphor .  her tone has now evened out no more redness (yes extreme fair skin).  She is thrilled with the changes and its only week and half in.I wish all those who suffer with these issues the best of luck, and THANK YOU Paula's choice.

Review: I rarely write reviews because I don’t come across a lot of products that I am blown away.But if you can tell by my comparison photo, I’ve made PRETTY DRASTIC improvements with my skin within a month! So I had to share my thoughts and experiences!I used the product every night before bed with a cotton ball for about a month now.To give you some background, I played college tennis 10 years ago. I was out in the sun all the time for practice. I have hyperpigmentation, large pores, oily face, fungal acne/bumps, and acne scars. Ive had it all. I also hated putting on sunscreen back then because I hate the oily texture of sunscreen with sweat mixed together so I was taking in UVA/UVB at full strength with beaming rays in warm SoCal sun for many many years.Fast forward 10 years, I’ve been pretty religious with skincare since graduating college because I realized that I’ve done huge damage to my skin. I made progress during those 10 years with consistency, but there were still some room for improvements as you can see in the photo. With age, I started seeing some wrinkles under my eyes and and on my forehead as well. I started getting all serious about skincare again a month ago by revisiting my usual selections to see what I can introduce into my routine. I found this product on YouTube, some blog post, and then Amazon. Decided to take a stab with the huge amount of reviews.BEST DECISION EVER!I saw changes within a few days of use! Skin started getting smoother and then pores looked somewhat smaller. After some improvements the first week, I did not see drastic improvements again till week 3. Started seeing changes in hyperpigmentation and smoothness of my skin. Also my wrinkles have somewhat faded under my eyes and forehead.Please note, I did try using it twice a day, but my skin started getting very flaky and sensitive. I think I broke out a little bit too so I had to go back to just once per day. I’d like to add, purging period is part of the process. Don't panic. Just be patient and you will see results. As they say, no pain no gain.I never thought I’d be here in a month with all of the pre-existing skin issues I had, but I can confidently say I am confident in my own skin at 33! This is probably the best skin I’ve ever had!  I can finally feel confident makeup free. When I do put on makeup, I don’t have to put on multiple layers of makeup or strategically use concealer to cover up the uneven texture or blemishes. Also my skin looks like it radiates through my makeup now. I saw someone say in the comments here how it’s like having instagram filter IRL. I totally agree. I don’t need no instagram filter! It’s called real life glowy skin!To add to the usage of this product, I also did make a switch in my routine by adding Cetaphil Purifying Clay Mask. I used the clay mask every other day. So it could be a combination of reasons for these results. But I think my comparison photo speaks for itself - Please give it one month of consistent use. Be consistent and you will see huge results! Review: I wish I had thought to take before/after photos of the KP I've dealt with on my thighs for most of my life. I have tried several other (and, in many cases, more expensive) products that claim to specifically combat KP over the years. Some of them even include many of the same ingredients as FAB's KP eraser scrub. Many exfoliants or acid acne treatments have similar components as well. I have to tell you, though: I never, not even once, noticed any positive change or results from using other products that claimed the same target.** Please note that KP is not the same thing as enlarged pores, folliculitis, razor bumps, dry/itchy winter skin, or body acne; eczema, psoriasis, allergies, and infections (fungal types or ingrown hairs can become infected) can overlap, exacerbate, or mimic symptoms and appearance, but KP is it's own thing, usually genetic, that causes excess keratin to build up around and sometimes block a hair follicle. You may see some improvement or not if you have another condition and are using this to help. If you have a chronic skin condition of any kind, see a dermatologist or other expert to know for certain what you're dealing with, before attempting to treat your skin. **My KP was much worse in my youth on my extremely fair skin. I resigned myself early in life to never really showing my legs unless forced. Now that I've tried this, I actually stand a chance of wanting to wear a pair of shorts one of these days and not feel nearly as self-conscious. I noticed an immediate difference in the texture of my skin and the reduction of my more troubling KP bumps where the keratin plug/hair follicle was particularly noticeable or pigmented and raised. FIRST USE RESULTS. And I'm not so easily impressed, but I've been loving it more and more as time goes by, so it wasn't simply honeymoon phase.The exfoliant has what I can only describe as a gritty, almost cement-like texture and appearance straight from the tube, a little stiffer than toothpaste and salt mixed together, less granular than sugar scrubs to me. You don't need a lot of it even for large problem areas -- it has good mileage/coverage -- and you don't really need to scrub to death (in fact, not recommended; this buffs away what needs to go and includes pumice bits so you don't necessarily need a pumice stone or anything). I use it on the areas in question or affected and nowhere else -- I have body washes and other such stuff for the rest of my body... This is made for KP and that's what I target.The first time, I used maybe a half-inch amount on each inner thigh, spread it gently with my fingers, and then used my pumice stone in small light circles over the most troublesome areas. Since then, I've only been using my konjac sponge, and a little less product overall. I go through the rest of my shower routine making sure to wash it away properly but I don't use other exfoliants or scrubs on these areas. I have sensitive (redhead) skin and don't want to make it any more sensitive and prone to sunburn than it already is without the help of a vague chemical peel. Still, twenty minutes after showering, I can feel the areas tingling lightly, and that's how I know the magic is truly happening at the level it needs to be happening on. It doesn't burn, itch, or irritate at all, and doesn't leave any dryness or any build-up in it's wake. It also doesn't have any detectable smell. Even though I could still see the more irritated, raised KP bumps, the texture and feel was so remarkably different and reduced, I could hardly believe my fingers. For me, this is huge, because if I can FEEL the bumps, I'm prone to picking at the larger ones until I've gone from little keratin bumps to full bloody sores.Using this scrub about twice a week, for almost 2 months now, I'm amazed at the new texture of my troubled areas. I've even noticed an overall reduction in the development of new plugs which I thought would never be the case. Yes, I tried it once on a rough patch at my elbow and it smoothed it out, as any good exfoliant likely would, but I'm not wasting this miraculous stuff on anything but my KP bumps.

Review Title: This stuff is the holy grail for KP
Review: Bought this around one month ago. The before and after is unbelievable. It took a couple weeks to get my skin adjusted to it, but I have less than a quarter of the bumps I had before I started. There is still some redness, yes, but it has been reduced significantly. Of all the lotions and creams I've used, this is the only thing that's made a significant difference. I recommend using it in a very strict routine, you can really tell when you've gone a few extra days without using it. I use it twice a week. KP is an excess of keratin in the skin, and the only way to curb that is to keep treatment consistent. I apply this in the shower to my upper arms (once the skin has been under warm water for some time and gotten soft) and rub it in in a circle pattern with one of those Korean beauty cloths. I find using the cloth protects my hands (the pumice in this product can be tough), adds another layer of physical exfoliation,  and the cloth doesn't absorb the product like a loofah or a rag does. It's great, totally worth the price for how much is needed to see results (for me it's only a quarter or so sized dollop on each arm!) Be sure to use lotion afterward, but nothing terribly heavy.

Review Title: This mitt will exfoliate years off of you!
Review: I purchased this on November 4th, of 2015 and I've used it 4 times in the last month prior to writing this review.When I really, really like something I will write an entire essay of a review.This mitt does exactly what it is advertised to do! You know that you are using it correctly when it feels almost unpleasant, but not painful.I know that pain is subjective to the individual but for me I know for a fact that what I don't find painful quite a few others would whine their little pants off over.Firstly let me say this: I am not stranger to exfoliation. The Salux Japanese Nylon Cloth has been a long-tome favorite of mine, however, they do soften up quickly and lose the sort of effectiveness that I enjoy - effectiveness itself.Also, they are getting rather pricey and I am weary of ordering them online for what I do not consider to be a practical price point.That aside, let me just get one thing clear - the Salux cloth never, ever, did for me exfoliation-wise what this Dermasuri mitt has done right from the first use. I didn't use the 5 minute shower method. To me soaking in a very warm bath (if at all possible) always made much more sense to soften up skin than standing under some running water. I filled up my tub using the warmest water I tolerate and the immersed myself up to my neck for a period of a 10 minute soak. Make sure your legs and arms stay under the water, you can also flip over onto your tummy for a few minutes too so that the front of you is evenly softened up also.After the 10 minutes and right before trying my mitt out for the first time I thought, "Hey, I bet it would really help the exfoliation process of I washed first with Dr Bronner's soap..". I figured it would remove any lotions/oils from my skin and really allow the mitt to "grab on" to the dead skin and roll it away. Sure enough, it worked like a charm. I dampened the mitt, wrung it out with both hands, put it on my hand, and then went to town vigorously rubbing in an up and down motion on my forearm (good test spot!), and wow the skin rolled right off like magic, truly like promised. I could feel the skin rolling under as I rubbed with the mitt, literally felt it through the mitt material.I used it on my legs, tummy, hips, back, and even the tops and sides of my feet and between my toes, what a wonderful mitt this is. Not to gross you out but you won't believe all of the skin you'll see in the tub after you unplug the drain and the tub empties. And to think; all of that was stuck on your body, making your skin look like crap, impeding your lotions and creams from penetrating your skin and actually moisturizing you..Because under all of that dead skin your poor little suffocated healthy skin is not being cared for, no moisture is reaching it, heck you may even be experiencing "winter itch" year-round thinking it's all the dry air when in reality all you needed was a good exfoliation.Anyways, buy this mitt, it works when you follow the instructions and it's way cheaper than a Baiden mitt, that's for sure!Things to note are:1) Warm soak in a bath2) Clean skin prior to exfoliating (preferable with an all natural soap so you don't leave any residues behind)3) Rub up and down fairly quickly using a very firm, even, pressure. (this may tire your arms out but it really gets that skin off!)4) Moisturize your newly exposed dewy, translucent, glowy, beautiful and healthy skin, and expect a ridiculous amount of compliments on how dang soft you are.*Don't use this on either your face or your neck/chest.

It works when used properly- a derm friend once told me to make sure I spend quality time with my microdermabrasions lol. Use on wet, clean skin (preferably after a warm steam) and apply a small amount, working the product into small circles. Concentrate on areas little by little- go in circles the diameter of about a quarter. Do not rub too harshly and make sure to avoid the eye area where the skin is thin. Add water if needed as you are going along as the product did tend to dry up a bit on my face but comes quickly back to life with a dab of water.I do recommend this before the shower. I like to steam my face with a washcloth, use this before I hop in, then take my normal shower so I can really rinse every little particle off. Never going back to the crazy expensive brand I was using. I actually preferred this quite a bit more to that one, as well as compared to a couple of other drugstore/makeup store brands I’ve tried in the past.
